verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a monitoring platform like Sentry, for example bulk-resolving or bulk-assigning issues, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents acting on many items at once. The traces table and dashboards only display many items, and the CLI probe confirms a CLI exists without describing any bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
